items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: my son was at the City Attorney's office, and I told him that I thought that he probably should go into entertainment law

ctx.x: At what point in your record company career did your son join you in the legal department? I know he's an attorney, right?
Yeah. Well, what happened -- my son was at the City Attorney's office, and I told him that I thought that he probably should go into entertainment law, you know.

I got him, probably pointed in that direction - we both attended USC and took a course in entertainment law one year, and it was kind of interesting to him, so that was just a way to give him a little feel of the thing.
